# PROCESS — cand_0002 (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage = #tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Wrong reservation selected** — agent grabs the FIRST reservation instead of matching the user's described route; picks UM3OG5 (SEA→DFW) instead of FQ8APE (Newark/EWR→Chicago/ORD) | 17, 22 (always-fail, ~5 non-noise trials) | agent never enumerates + route-matches; ignores that requested upgrade is "already done" (a wrong-reservation signal) | CAPABILITY-GAP + KNOWLEDGE | NEW loop tool `list_reservations` (routes w/ city names) + policy route-match procedure |
| 2 | **Cancel eligibility not gated** — agent executes disallowed cancels (flown NQNU5R; ineligible basic-econ IFOYYZ), corrupting DB; or transfers before doing the permitted upgrade | 37 | `cancel_reservation` does no policy check; agent over-acts / premature transfer | DECISION + RULE-VIOLATION | CODE flown-segment guard on `cancel_reservation` + policy eligibility gate + "finish permitted write before transfer" |
| 3 | **Passenger name-change stalls** — agent asks user for an unchanged dob, then transfers when refused, instead of reading it from the reservation | 40 | `update_reservation_passengers` requires full dob; agent treats missing dob as a blocker | CAPABILITY-GAP | CODE: auto-fill missing `dob` positionally from existing reservation + policy reuse rule |
| 4 | **Conditional go-ahead not recognized** — user "if X impossible, cancel with insurance"; agent re-asks to confirm; confirmation+###STOP### arrive together, write stranded | 19 | agent doesn't treat a satisfied conditional as a go-ahead | BEHAVIORAL/KNOWLEDGE | policy: conditional go-ahead = go-ahead (gated behind confirmed eligibility) |
| 5 | **"Same flight as before" guessed** — agent infers flight from recalled departure time instead of reading the prior reservation | 8 (t1) | knowledge gap | KNOWLEDGE | policy Book-flight rule |
| 6 | **"Cheapest" not enumerated** — agent picks first-listed connecting leg (HAT021 $453) not cheapest (HAT100 $259) | 23 (t2) | knowledge gap | KNOWLEDGE | policy Book-flight rule |
| — | confirm-then-narrate / yes+###STOP### with no further turn | 8 t2, 12 t1, 23 t1 | episode ends on the confirmation turn (simulator appends ###STOP###) | (partly infra) | reinforced by rank-4 "present one summary early / act immediately"; NOT re-attempted with fresh prose beyond that |

## Edits shipped (each passed REAL + SAFE + VERIFIED)
| # | cluster | class | file/tool | what & why general | blast-radius class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 17/22 | loop tool (lever 5) | tools.py `list_reservations` (NEW) | returns every reservation with human route "Newark (EWR) -> Chicago (ORD)" so the agent can route-match | BOUNDED/additive — new READ tool; no passing task's write path uses it |
| 2 | 37 | in-body guard (lever 1/3) | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | raise if any segment date < current date (flown → transfer). General policy rule the API doesn't enforce | BOUNDED — fires only on flown reservations; no passing task cancels |
| 3 | 40 | normalization (lever 1) | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | accept partial dicts; auto-fill missing `dob` positionally from existing reservation; actionable count-mismatch error | BOUNDED — fires only when dob omitted; no passing task uses this tool |
| 4 | 17/22 | policy procedure | policy.md Modify flight | ordered "Finding the right reservation": list_reservations→route-match→already-satisfied=wrong→ask if ambiguous, + worked example | additive knowledge; single-reservation tasks unaffected |
| 5 | 40 | policy rule | policy.md Change passengers | reuse unchanged fields via get_reservation_details; don't ask/transfer for a fetchable dob | additive |
| 6 | 37 | policy gate | policy.md Cancel flight | check eligibility before cancel; never cancel flown; finish permitted write before transferring | additive; NARROWS refusal (safe direction) + completes pending writes (matches passing 37 t0) |
| 7 | 19 | policy rule | policy.md Executing a confirmed action | conditional go-ahead counts once condition settled + eligibility confirmed; present one summary early | additive; gated behind eligibility |
| 8 | 8/23 | policy rules | policy.md Book flight | "same flight" → read prior reservation; "cheapest" → enumerate all, pick min-total | additive knowledge |

## Verify-the-fix (ran tool bodies on exact trace args in tau2-bench/.venv against live airline DB)
- `cancel_reservation('NQNU5R')` → guard FIRES ("segments HAT214,HAT045 already departed before 2024-05-15"). Blast radius: `cancel_reservation('Z7GOZK')` (task19 gold) and `('K1NW8N')` (task23 gold) both cancel OK → guard does NOT fire. No passing task cancels.
- `update_reservation_passengers('3RK2T9',[{Anya Garcia},{Mei Garcia}])` (no dobs) → fills [Anya Garcia 1992-11-12, Mei Garcia 1989-12-13] = gold exactly. Blast radius: full-dob call is a no-op (unchanged); count-mismatch raises actionable error. No passing task uses this tool.
- `list_reservations('omar_rossi_1241')` → 4 rows; only FQ8APE has destination Chicago(ORD) → disambiguates "New York to Chicago". Registers as tool #15 (get_tools has 'list_reservations').
- PROTECTED regression check: task 11 `update_reservation_flights(GV1N64 → basic_economy)` refund=5244, cabin=basic_economy (unchanged); task 25 `book_reservation` split 128+247 → charged 375 (unchanged). Both write tools (book_reservation, update_reservation_flights) were NOT edited this iteration.
- `ast.parse` OK; module imports; 15 tools register.

## Blast-radius / SAFE summary
- Passing tasks 11, 25: writes go through book_reservation / update_reservation_flights (untouched) → verified identical output. New tool + two guards are all bounded/additive.
- No global permission/refusal rule was loosened. The one ACT-leaning prompt addition (conditional go-ahead, rank 7) is gated behind confirmed eligibility; the cancel prompt rule (rank 6) NARROWS (adds refusal for ineligible/flown) — the safe direction.

## Process & features used
- Parallel diagnosis: fanned out 4 read-only subagents (17/22, 8/23, 19/40, 12/37+passing 11/25 blast-radius recon). Merged all findings into this one candidate.
- Verified every code edit by executing the tool body against the live DB on the exact failing-trace args, plus a no-op check on passing-task args.

## Deliberately skipped / partial
- yes+###STOP### confirm-then-no-write (8 t2, 23 t1): largely a simulator artifact (write turn never arrives). Addressed only indirectly by "present one summary early / act on first go-ahead"; did NOT add more prose reminders of the already-present execute-on-yes rule (would repeat cand_0001).
- Task 37 IFOYYZ (basic-econ, >24h, no insurance, NOT flown): can't be code-gated (cancel takes no reason arg); left to the policy eligibility gate.
- Did NOT add a code guard blocking basic_economy modification: gold for 17/22 upgrades a basic_economy cabin, and policy allows cabin change on basic economy — such a guard would regress the very tasks it targets.
